{{Top|leg}}
'''Dendrite''' was a material that was used to make clothing by the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]]. They used it to create long hooded robes.<ref name="RM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> Dendrite was also used in creating photocell capacitors.<ref name="KFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
